# Every example's own tests, on all six targets, copied in as the repository
# ships them. An example's recorded answers are its testdata/http, which the
# script harness's server serves under /examples/{name}/
# (internal/testhttp), and `./...` leaves testdata out of the walk.
#
# html runs each component a test takes as a page of its own, so an example
# whose window is served in route mode is tested as a static page there too.
#
# 90 is every example's tests together, so one dropping out of the walk fails.
#
# A test that sets no locale reads the process's, and the examples' tests that
# set none read English.

env LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8
exec cp -r $SNGL_ROOT/examples .

sngl test --platform=none ./examples/...
stdout '^ok +90 tests, 0 failures$'
! stdout SKIP

sngl test --platform=html ./examples/...
stdout '^ok +90 tests, 0 failures$'
! stdout SKIP

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go ./examples/...
stdout '^ok +90 tests, 0 failures$'
! stdout SKIP

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go ./examples/...
stdout '^ok +90 tests, 0 failures$'
! stdout SKIP

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go ./examples/...
stdout '^ok +90 tests, 0 failures$'
! stdout SKIP

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin ./examples/...
stdout '^ok +90 tests, 0 failures$'
! stdout SKIP
